mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.helmet_id, a.helmet_type, a.battery_level, a.ip, a.mac_address, a.assigned_person, a.assigned_workshop, a.assigned_process, a.assigned_team, a.motion_status, a.create_by, a.create_date, a.update_by, a.update_date, a.remarks FROM swm_helmet_device a WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.id, a.helmet_id, a.helmet_type, a.battery_level, a.ip, a.mac_address, a.assigned_person, a.assigned_workshop, a.assigned_process, a.assigned_team, a.motion_status, a.create_by, a.create_date, a.update_by, a.update_date, a.remarks FROM swm_helmet_device a WHERE (a.assigned_person IS NULL OR a.assigned_person = '')
AND a.helmet_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO swm_helmet_device( id, helmet_id, helmet_type, battery_level, ip, mac_address, assigned_person, assigned_workshop, assigned_process, assigned_team, motion_status, create_by, create_date, update_by, update_date, remarks ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{helmetId}, #{helmetType}, #{batteryLevel}, #{ip}, #{macAddress}, #{assignedPerson}, #{assignedWorkshop}, #{assignedProcess}, #{assignedTeam}, #{motionStatus}, #{createBy}, #{createDate}, #{updateBy}, #{updateDate}, #{remarks} )
mapper.update: UPDATE swm_helmet_device SET helmet_id = #{helmetId}, helmet_type = #{helmetType}, battery_level = #{batteryLevel}, ip = #{ip}, mac_address = #{macAddress}, assigned_person = #{assignedPerson}, assigned_workshop = #{assignedWorkshop}, assigned_process = #{assignedProcess}, assigned_team = #{assignedTeam}, motion_status = #{motionStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_date = #{updateDate}, remarks = #{remarks} WHERE id = #{id}
